name: Mapillary
description: Street-level photos from Mapillary for a box, narrowed by when they were taken and whether they are panoramas, at the size you choose. Each image keeps its photographer, capture time and place. Also the signs and objects Mapillary detected in the photos, as points. Needs your Mapillary access token.

resources.name: Street-level images
resources.description: Photos taken along streets and paths, each with its photographer, capture time, heading and place.

parameters.label: Area
parameters.description: The box to take images from.

parameters.label: Taken between
parameters.description: Only images taken in these dates.

parameters.label: Size
parameters.description: The width of each image, in pixels.

parameters.label: Most images
parameters.description: Images are taken from across the box, newest first, up to this many.

resources.name: Map features
resources.description: Signs, markings and street objects Mapillary detected in its photos, as points.

parameters.label: Area
parameters.description: The box to take features from.
